items.title: Three equivalent chart tests for relative pseudo-coherence of complexes on algebraic spaces
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y locally of finite type between spaces over S, m in Z, E in D_QCoh(O_X), the lemma proves the equivalence of: (1) E|_U is m-pseudo-coherent relative to V for every etale chart square from schemes U, V; (2) the same for one surjective chart; (3) for every affine chart square, RGamma(U, E) is m-pseudo-coherent relative to O_X(U) over O_Y(V). The retained proof is complete: (1)=>(3) imports the schemes dictionary More on Morphisms, lemma qcoh-relative-pseudo-coherence-characterize; (3)=>(2) covers the chart by affines and reapplies the same dictionary; (2)=>(1) is the written comparison — for any second chart, pass to the fibre product U'' over V'' factoring through V' x_Y V, descend along the fppf-stability lemma (card L16106) and the post-composition invariance (card L16115), then pull back along the etale map whose pseudo-coherence input is finite-presentation (cards L16168/L16151-era dictionary; the cited lemmas relative-pseudo-coherent-descends-fppf, relative-pseudo-coherent-post-compose, pull-relative-pseudo-coherent, flat-finite-presentation-pseudo-coherent are all on record). The equivalence licenses the D_QCoh-only definition used by the two neighbouring characterization cards. Retained author proof at lines 10786-10831.
